# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are considered for the latest published v1.x release. Earlier
development snapshots are not supported release lines.

## Reporting A Vulnerability

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting from the repository Security tab.
Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Include the affected version or commit, impact, reproduction steps, and any
known mitigation. Reports should use synthetic or local Development data only.
Never include access tokens, RCON passwords, private keys, production
connection strings, or third-party server data.

The maintainer will assess the report and coordinate disclosure through the
private advisory. This personal project does not promise a response or fix SLA.

If private vulnerability reporting is temporarily unavailable, wait for the
private channel to be restored rather than publishing sensitive details.
